text: Dear Joe Camel, 6-14-97 What up Desert Dude? I have a major prob. I have bunches of Camel bucks & find I have no way to spend them! Is it possible to still get a catalog? Talco have a brainstorm on your packers it says you can't afford promotions. Marlboro still has their miles although they threatened to stop & didn't. Why don't you charge an extra 5¢ a pack. If people truly would "Walk a Mile for a Camel," they'll pay it & you can bring the Camel Cash back. By the way I love your matchbook covers. I've been collecting them... Most sincerely, W. Alan M. Southworth P.O. Box #4501 Lima Oh. 45802 Send CC9
